Reflection:
To set up the left and right tab stops we first need to open the Paragraph dialog (where the Tabs setup lives). That means clicking the “Format” menu and then selecting “Paragraph…”.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Click the "Format" menu at its center
pyautogui.click(292, 74)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Click the first item ("Paragraph…") in the dropdown
# which appears just below the Format menu
pyautogui.click(292, 97)
time.sleep(0.5)
```
